text: When God's people remembered Zion, Zion is Jerusalem, and so we know from the context of the Psalm exactly what has taken place. God's people have been dragged away into Babylonian captivity, so they sit by the rivers of Babylon. The reason they're dragged away into Babylonian captivity is God had told His people when He brought them into the promised land after He had rescued them from Egyptian slavery that if you worship Me, you'll enjoy this land, but if you worship other little G gods, I'm going to remove you from.
